scope: Direct URIjs-style calls; symbol wrapper; no crawler work

protocol.order: Six permutations repeated three times; second observation reverses each order
protocol.filter: Reject whole round when maximum bracketing CPU probe exceeds 1.5 times median calibration maximum
protocol.control: 95% interval includes zero and lies inside [-5,+5] percent
protocol.classification: Control must pass and both wrapper copies must agree on direction
protocol.stopping: Fixed rounds, no retries or threshold changes; abort on output mismatch
protocol.timing: Warm direct API batches; inputs/pools and forced GC outside timing; result consumption inside timing
protocol.semantics: Canonical equivalent inputs only; does not cover known WHATWG/URIjs behavior differences
protocol.host: Record host before/after; if busy, retain as diagnostic without waiting or retrying
